_comment: Sprint 9-DS-r4 P2-14 — English translation. Sprint 15 NEW-3 — extended to mirror the full ru.json key tree across 12 priority pages. Professional treasury / DeFi vocabulary (Position Health, Total Earned, Unclaimed Fees, etc.). i18n bundle parity tested in src/test/i18n.test.ts.

nav.modeTooltipSimple: Simple mode: buy/sell and liquidity with default settings
nav.modeTooltipPro: Pro mode: bins, strategies, advanced tools

login.subtitle: Next-generation liquidity platform
login.errorFallback: Invalid email or password. Please try again.

tiles_sub.openPositionToEarn: open a position to start earning fees

tooltips.portfolio: Value of all your tokens (free + locked) plus liquidity in open LP positions, at the latest market prices.
tooltips.activePositions: The number of your open LP positions. Each is a range of bins where you provide liquidity and earn fees.
tooltips.unclaimedFees: Fees accrued from swaps inside your active positions. Claim them any time with the "Claim all" button on the Positions page.
tooltips.totalEarned: All claimed fees plus your current unrealized P&L on positions relative to the initial deposit.

swap.title: Swap
swap.subtitle: Instant token swap through DLMM pools

quote.priceImpactTooltip: The difference between the pool's current market price and the actual execution price of your swap. Large swaps eat bin liquidity → impact grows. Normal: < 1%; > 5% = reconsider the size.

alerts.noPool: No active pool for the selected pair

info.readyHint: Pick a pair — you'll see the route and price impact
info.noDirectPool: No direct pool for this pair

simple.pageSubtitle: Buy, sell or manage liquidity — without bins and strategies. Everything on default settings.
simple.marketNote: Market trade against {{base}}. A {{slippage}}% slippage tolerance is applied automatically.
simple.addNote: Default settings — earn on fees without picking a range.
simple.addHint: Tokens are placed in the pool within a ±{{range}} price-step range around the current price. While the price stays in range they earn a fee on every swap. If it leaves the range the position temporarily stops trading and earns again once the price returns. You can withdraw any time — the "Withdraw" tab.
simple.removeNote: Return liquidity to your balance. Pick a position and how much to withdraw — no ranges.
simple.noPositions: You have no open positions yet
simple.estimateNote: Rough estimate of the position body — excluding accrued fees and charges.

hedge.title: FX Hedge
hedge.intro: Lock in the ruble exchange rate against a foreign currency through DLMM pools — without leaving for SWIFT. A hedge works like an instant swap: SRUB converts to your chosen currency, you receive a tokenized position you can hold or unwind back.

exposure.label: Currency-risk exposure
exposure.tooltip: The amount of available rubles that can be converted into a foreign currency as a hedge.

candidates.title: Available hedge pairs
candidates.empty: No FX pairs available. Check that the catalog has active SRUB ↔ FIAT_BACKED pools.

calculator.title: Hedge calculator
calculator.selectPair: Select a pair on the left to compute a hedge
calculator.ratioLabel: What share of the SRUB position should we hedge?
calculator.ctaEnterAmount: Enter an amount or pick a share
calculator.footerNote: Hedge history below + full history on the Transactions page.

alerts.success: Hedge executed — tokens credited to your account

hedge.openHedgesEmpty: No open hedges. Create one with the calculator above — it will appear here with a quick-close button.

confirmClose.title: Close hedge?
confirmClose.body: A reverse swap of {{amount}} units back to SRUB will be executed.
confirmClose.expected: You'll receive approximately ~{{amount}} SRUB; the actual amount depends on the rate at execution time.

confirmCloseAll.title: Close all hedges ({{count}})?
confirmCloseAll.body: {{count}} open hedges totaling {{total}} SRUB will be closed sequentially.
confirmCloseAll.warning: This action cannot be undone. Each close is executed as a normal swap at the current rate.
confirmCloseAll.note: Hedges are closed sequentially — this gives more predictable pool price impact than parallel execution.

errors.noPoolData: Hedge transaction is missing data needed to unwind

pools.title: Liquidity pools
pools.subtitle_one: {{count}} pair available for trading and providing liquidity
pools.subtitle_other: {{count}} pairs available for trading and providing liquidity

empty.noResultsHint: Try adjusting the search query or clearing the filter.

yieldCalc.title: Yield calculator
yieldCalc.noApy: Not enough APY data to project
yieldCalc.disclaimer: Estimate at the current APY: depends on trading volume and staying in range, excludes impermanent loss (IL).

kpi.apySourceLiveHint: Computed from real swap volume over the last 24 hours.
kpi.apySourceModelHint: Little real volume yet — showing a per-fee-tier estimate at a typical ~3.3% daily turnover.

outOfRange.title: {{count}} of your positions — out of price range
outOfRange.description: An out-of-range position earns no fees. Click "Rebalance" to migrate it to the current price with the same capital and strategy.

rebalanceAll.title: Rebalance {{count}} positions?
rebalanceAll.body: Each out-of-range position will be closed sequentially, then reopened with the same capital, strategy and range width but centered on the current price (bin {{binId}}).
rebalanceAll.warning: This is a sequential operation — if something fails mid-way, already-migrated positions stay migrated. Do not close this tab until it finishes.
rebalanceAll.failure: Failed to migrate position {{id}}…: {{error}}. Migrated {{done}} of {{total}}.

externalRef.label: External reference
externalRef.tooltip: The pool's internal price {{internal}} deviates from the real market ({{source}}) by {{delta}}%. A large deviation = an arbitrage opportunity.

chart.title: Price ({{quote}})
chart.noData: Not enough data for a chart — it will appear after trades
chart.sparse: Few trades — the chart is still sparse. Points will appear as real swaps happen.

addLiq.singleSidedX: Single-sided: {{sym}} will sit in bins ABOVE the active one — like sell orders.
addLiq.singleSidedY: Single-sided: {{sym}} will sit in bins BELOW the active one — like buy orders.
addLiq.capitalTooltip: In {{sym}} units. For non-SRUB pairs without a separate FX conversion.
addLiq.bookkeepingTooltip: Estimated cost of bookkeeping the position in the pool's ledger. Replaced by the real formula in Sprint 10 after the 1C audit.
addLiq.protocolFeeTooltip: The DLMM protocol fee applies to swaps, not to liquidity deposits. So it is always 0 at this step.
addLiq.priceImpactTooltip: If your deposit shifts the active bin's ratio, the pool price moves. The larger it is relative to TVL, the bigger the shift. Above 2% — splitting the deposit into several parts is recommended.

positions.title: My positions

empty.title: You don't have any open positions yet
empty.desc: Add liquidity to a DLMM pool and start earning fees on every swap.
empty.filteredDesc: No position falls under the selected health filter.

positions.subtitle: Your LP positions in DLMM pools — bin ranges, unclaimed fees, payout history

table.healthTooltip: Heuristic position health score: range fit, fee earning, age. Not investment advice.
table.pnlTooltip: Current position value minus initial deposit (in quote-token units). Excludes fees — those have their own column.
table.pnlLegacyTooltip: Position opened before Sprint 9-DS-r4 — no initial deposit recorded.
table.noClaimTooltip: No fees accrued yet — the position is working, but fee accrual hasn't run yet

confirmClaimAll.title: Claim fees on all positions ({{count}})?
confirmClaimAll.body: Accrued fees will be collected from {{count}} positions. Positions stay open and keep earning.

confirmCloseAll.title: Close all positions ({{count}})?
confirmCloseAll.body: {{count}} active positions will be removed sequentially. Accrued fees from each are claimed at the same time.
confirmCloseAll.warning: This action cannot be undone. Each removal is a real transaction and may shift the pool price.
confirmCloseAll.note: Positions close sequentially — this gives more predictable price impact and helps localize any failure.

removeModal.title: Remove liquidity
removeModal.body: What percentage of liquidity should be removed from position {{pair}}?

messages.removeFailure: Failed to remove position {{id}}…: {{error}}. Closed {{done}} of {{total}}.
messages.claimFailure: Failed to claim position {{id}}…: {{error}}. Claimed from {{done}} of {{total}}.

empty.title: No transactions yet
empty.desc: Make a swap or a liquidity operation and it will show up here.
empty.filteredDesc: No transaction falls under the selected filters.

orders.title: Limit orders
orders.subtitle: Buy or sell at the price you want — the order fills automatically once the market reaches it. Place an order from a pool page on the "Limit" tab.

cancelConfirm.title: Cancel order?
cancelConfirm.description: The reserved funds will be returned to your balance.

orders.empty: You don't have any limit orders yet

kyc.label: Verification status (KYC)
kyc.pendingTitle: Your verification request is under review
kyc.pendingBody: Reviews usually take 1-2 business days. After verification you will have full access to platform features.
kyc.notSubmittedBody: Complete KYC verification to unlock trading and liquidity management.
kyc.rejectedBody: Your verification request was rejected. Please contact support.

settings.languageHint: Choose the language for labels and copy

onboarding.subtitle: Invite finance managers, accountants and auditors to work on a single legal entity. Every action is attributed to a specific user — the audit log is ready for regulator review.
onboarding.empty: You don't have an organization yet
onboarding.emptyDescription: Create one — and you'll be able to invite team members with different roles.

auditAlert.title: Audit log with user attribution
auditAlert.description: Every action by any team member (opening a position, swap, settings change) is recorded with the specific user. Visible in Transactions and used for compliance reviews.

table.name: Name
table.removeConfirmDescription: After removal the user will lose access to all organization operations. The audit log for past actions is retained.

team.footnote: Frontend MVP (Sprint 11): team state is stored locally in the owner's browser. The backend version (Sprint 12) — POST /api/v1/orgs/{orgId}/members + gateway permission middleware — will distribute state across all team members and provide cross-device sync.

createOrg.title: Create organization
createOrg.orgNamePlaceholder: Transport Holding, Sole Proprietor Ivanov, Kontur LLC…
createOrg.successMessage: Organization "{{name}}" created. You are the Owner.

invite.title: Invite member
invite.duplicateError: A user with this email is already in the team

rebalance.title: Portfolio rebalance
rebalance.subtitle: Align your actual asset allocation with the target structure in one click

view.alertBody: Total portfolio value: {{total}}. Move to the "Target" step to set desired shares.

plan.alertBody: Allocations must sum to 100%. Currently: {{sum}}%. Tolerance: ±0.5% — rebalance will not swap tokens within the tolerance band.

execute.noOpAlert: All shares are within tolerance — rebalance not needed
execute.note: Routed via SRUB as the pivot currency. Execution stops on the first failure — balances do not need to be rolled back.

reviews.title: Customer reviews
reviews.subtitle: Feedback from pilot users of the DLMM platform

pro.title: Pro metrics
